_comment: WCSim BoxandLine20inchHQE head-on detection per photon arriving at the PMT, as the HK production runs it (WCSim v1.12.34, PMTQEMethod SensitiveDetector_Only, PMTCollEff on), written by scripts/make_wcsim_pmt_optics.py: qe = A0(lambda) x QE_table/0.73 x 1/(1 - 0.25) x QEFF x CE 0.95, A0 the head-on absorbed fraction of WCSim's default photocathode (rgcff 0.32: the front water -> glass reflection and the bounces between the two surfaces included; 0.6772 at 400 nm). LUCiD's QE is this head-on detection in every reflection model.
